system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> you should add a feature that allows you to cross fade between songs by tapping and holding the next song button. Sincerely, Person that never lets songs finish"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey there! We have more info about this here: <URL> Give us a shout if you have any questions"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks personalization and doesn't address the feature suggestion directly."}
